description: MainActivity.java defines the main launcher activity for an Android app, managing UI fragments, menu options, dialogs, and notifications.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity managing UI fragments, menu actions, dialogs, and notifications.

classes.name: MyDialogFragment
classes.description: Inner static class implementing a simple dialog fragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, restores state, sets layout, and configures UI elements.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and removes camera item if feature unsupported.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, updates toggle titles based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for camera, toggle titles, theme, dialog, and notifications.

methods.name: toggleVisibleTitles
methods.description: Animates showing/hiding of the titles fragment with custom animation.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intents with ACTION_DIALOG to show dialogs.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog fragment with specified text.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays standard or custom notifications.

methods.name: getDialogPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for dialog actions triggered from notifications.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves theme and titles visibility state.
